title: A Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of Neihulizumab vs "Conventional Treatment" to Treat Sr-aGvHD
brief_summary: This study is to assess the efficacy of Neihulizumab versus "conventional therapy" and to evaluate safety, pharmacokinetics and immunogenicity in treating steroid-refractory acute Graft-vs-Host Disease
condition: Steroid-refractory aGvHD Subsequent to Allogeneic Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation
